response.headline: Mag 7? MANGOS? SpaceX forces name rethink on Wall Street's tech-stock moniker

The IPO, the biggest in U.S. history, vaulted SpaceX's value above two Mag 7 members: ‌CEO Elon Musk's other company, Tesla, and Meta Platforms.  With SpaceX's arrival, "it becomes very hard to keep using Mag 7 as the clean shorthand for market leadership because one of the most important companies in the world would immediately be outside the label," said Shay Boloor, chief market strategist at Futurum Equities.
